import json, random, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import ctypes; ctypes.CDLL('/workspace/vendor/system-libs/libz.so.1', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
import reference
from netnomos.finite import compile_job

def build(nf, slots, extra=()):
    fields=[{'name':'f%d'%i,'type':['time','size','count','id','flag'][i%5],'domain':[0,1]} for i in range(nf)]
    preds=[]
    for c in range(nf*slots):
        f=fields[c%nf]['name']; s=c//nf; t=fields[c%nf]['type']
        preds.append({'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[s,f]},'op':'eq','right':{'const':0,'type':t}})
        preds.append({'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[s,f]},'op':'eq','right':{'const':1,'type':t}})
    cells=nf*slots
    rows=[]
    for a in range(cells):
        for b in range(a+1,cells):
            row=[1 if c in (a,b) else 0 for c in range(cells)]
            rows.append([row[i*nf:(i+1)*nf] for i in range(slots)])
    rng=random.Random(1)
    queries=[{'fixed':[],'target':[rng.randrange(slots),rng.choice(fields)['name']],'prefix':p} for p in ('','0','1','10') for _ in range(2)]
    return {'fields':fields,'slots':slots,'predicates':preds,'width':4,'train':rows,
            'approved':[list(c) for c in [(0,1),(2,4,6),(5,9)]] ,'queries':queries}

for nf, slots in ((3,2),(4,2),(4,1)):
    job=build(nf,slots)
    exp=reference.solve(job); got=compile_job(job)
    print(nf, slots, 'rules', len(exp['rules']), len(got['rules']), 'match', json.dumps(exp,sort_keys=True)==json.dumps(got,sort_keys=True), 'active', got['active'])
